# espectacular

> Behavioral verification layer for the charly AI development ecosystem.

## Authorship

All code in this repository was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, design decisions, planning, and review.

Leer en español: https://charly-vibes.github.io/charly-vibes/

## Install

macOS & Linux via curl (latest release binary):

```bash
V=$(basename "$(curl -fsSLI -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' \
  https://github.com/charly-vibes/espectacular/releases/latest)" | sed 's/^v//')
TGT="$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')_$(uname -m | sed 's/^x86_64$/amd64/; s/^aarch64$/arm64/')"
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/charly-vibes/espectacular/releases/download/v${V}/ah_${V}_${TGT}.tar.gz" | tar xz
chmod +x ah && sudo mv ah /usr/local/bin/
```

Also: `brew tap charly-vibes/charly && brew install ah` or `cargo install espectacular`.
